items.text: Thank you for always ordering pies from our bakery for your special occasions. <break time="0.8s" /> We truly appreciate your continued support and always try to provide pies of the highest quality. <break time="0.8s" /> Unfortunately, we are writing to inform you that we are unable to prepare the apple pie you have ordered for the upcoming birthday celebration. <break time="0.8s" /> Due to a delayed apple harvest this season, we are currently experiencing difficulties sourcing fresh apples. <break time="0.8s" /> As a result, we are unable to fulfill the order that you have requested. <break time="0.8s" /> We sincerely apologize for this situation. <break time="0.8s" /> We appreciate your understanding and look forward to serving you again in the future.
